zh: 最近大家问得最多的一句话就是：
en: The question I hear most often lately is this:

zh: 超哥，现在学AI，到底能不能多挣一点钱？
en: Chao Ge, can learning AI actually help me earn more?

zh: 有上班的朋友说，工资就那样，
en: Some employed friends say their salary is just so-so,

zh: 想下班以后学点AI，看看能不能多一份收入。
en: so they want to learn AI after work and add another income stream.

zh: 也有暂时没有上班的朋友，觉得AI现在这么热，
en: Others are currently between jobs and see how hot AI is,

zh: 是不是干脆换一条路，专门做这个？
en: and wonder whether they should switch paths and do this full-time.

zh: 大家既怕错过AI，又怕花钱和花时间，
en: People fear missing AI, but also fear spending money and time

zh: 以后没有结果，于是在冲进去和干脆不碰之间摇摆。
en: without results, so they swing between rushing in and staying away.

zh: 我先把我的答案放前面。
en: Let me put my answer up front.

zh: AI值得学，但不同处境不能走同一条路。
en: AI is worth learning, but different situations require different paths.

zh: 有工作的人，先把AI放进现有工作里验证。
en: If you have a job, test AI inside the work you already do.

zh: 准备靠它谋生的人，先把成本、作品和真实交付周期，
en: If you plan to make a living from it, first examine the costs, portfolio, and real delivery cycle,

zh: 先想清楚。这不是我站在外面劝大家保守。
en: and think them through. I am not saying this as an outsider urging caution.

zh: 这是我大量花费和每天凌晨3点熬出来的感受。
en: This comes from substantial spending and many nights working until 3 a.m.

zh: 今年年初，我开始系统接触AI。
en: At the start of this year, I began studying AI systematically.

zh: 证书要花钱，课要花钱，工具订阅要花钱。
en: Certificates cost money, courses cost money, and tool subscriptions cost money.

zh: API、做图做视频的积分、资料和社群，零零散散都要花钱。
en: APIs, image and video credits, materials, and communities all add up.

zh: 时间更不用说，每天晚上和周末基本都搭进去了。
en: And then there is time: most evenings and weekends went into it.

zh: 后来我和合伙人一起做企业AI落地和GEO。
en: Later, my partner and I started working on enterprise AI implementation and GEO.

zh: 也有付费项目在做，也有交付，现在也还在接单。
en: We have paid projects, deliveries, and are still taking work.

zh: 可我不会把这就说成“我已经跑通了”。
en: But I will not call that proof that I have fully figured it out.

zh: 因为项目在做，和这条路已经跑顺，是两回事。
en: Having projects underway and having a proven path are two different things.

zh: 到今天，我自己的投入和回报也还没有成正比。
en: Even today, my own input and return are still not proportional.

zh: 所以我现在不敢劝你辞职干AI。
en: So I cannot tell you to quit your job for AI.

zh: 因为我也还在用投入、项目和交付，一段一段验证这条路。
en: I am still validating this path, step by step, through investment, projects, and delivery.

zh: 这不是说AI没有用，恰恰相反。
en: That does not mean AI is useless. Quite the opposite.

zh: AI很可能帮你把费时间的事，做得快一点、清楚一点。
en: AI can very likely make time-consuming work faster and clearer.

zh: 但它得先落到你手里那件真事上。
en: But it must first land on a real task in your hands.

zh: 你现在有工作，就先别急着把自己想成AI从业者。
en: If you have a job, do not rush to label yourself an AI professional.

zh: 你每天干的事，不管是写材料、整理客户，
en: In your daily work, whether you write documents or organize customer information,

zh: 还有这些报表，
en: or prepare reports,

zh: 还有做内容，总有一件事是你反复在做的。
en: or create content, there is always one task you repeat again and again.

zh: 先拿这一件去练。
en: Start by practicing on that one task.

zh: 豆包、DeepSeek、WorkBuddy给的免费额度也好，
en: Use the free quotas from Doubao, DeepSeek, or WorkBuddy,

zh: 或者自己小额充一点会员，先把它用起来。
en: or buy a small membership and start using it.

zh: 不是让AI替你糊弄过去。
en: The goal is not to let AI bluff its way through the task.

zh: 你要盯着看：它整理出来的东西，你自己能不能看懂？
en: Watch closely: can you understand what it produces?

zh: 交出去会不会出错？
en: Will it cause errors when you hand it over?

zh: 你是不是少绕了一圈、少返了几次工？
en: Did it save you a detour or several rounds of rework?

zh: 要是这你都用不顺，
en: If you still cannot use it smoothly,

zh: 就先别急着谈副业了。
en: do not rush into talking about a side business.

zh: 先把这些工具用顺。
en: First, learn to use these tools reliably.

zh: 这本身就在给你的工作能力加分。
en: That alone adds value to your professional ability.

zh: 准备全职进入这个行业的人，情况又不一样。
en: For people preparing to enter this field full-time, the situation is different.

zh: 你面对的不是会不会用一个工具，
en: Your question is not whether you can use one tool,

zh: 而是要不要拿时间和成本，去换一个还没验证的机会。
en: but whether to trade time and money for an opportunity that is not yet proven.

zh: 你先别看别人做一张图、做一个短剧，
en: Do not focus on someone making one image or one short drama,

zh: 一下就爆火了，一个月能接多少单。
en: going viral overnight, or claiming many orders in a month.

zh: 先问自己：我能承受多久没有收入？
en: Ask yourself: how long can I live without income?

zh: 我能拿出什么样的作品？
en: What work can I actually show?

zh: 我手上有没有一个真实的问题？
en: Do I have a real problem in front of me?

zh: 有没有愿意让我反复做、反复改，直到能用的需求方？
en: Is there a real client who will let me iterate until the result works?

zh: 没有这些，买再多课、开再多会员，
en: Without these, buying more courses and memberships

zh: 最后很容易只剩几个账号，
en: often leaves you with only a few accounts

zh: 和一堆没用完的积分。
en: and a pile of unused credits.

zh: 像AIGC做图、做视频、做漫剧，
en: AIGC images, videos, and animated dramas

zh: 这些方向当然可以研究，我自己也在持续做。
en: are all worth exploring, and I continue to work on them too.

zh: 但越往深处走，你越会发现，
en: But the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes:

zh: 它不是点两下就能挣钱。
en: you do not earn money simply by clicking twice.

zh: 投入、作品质量、素材权利、内容规则和反复修改，都会摆在面前。
en: Investment, quality, asset rights, content rules, and repeated revisions all matter.

zh: 尤其是完全没有接触过的小白，
en: Especially for complete beginners,

zh: 一上来就把所有时间和钱压进去，
en: putting all your time and money in from day one

zh: 我真不建议。
en: is something I genuinely do not recommend.

zh: 先把AI用在一件真实的事上。
en: First use AI on one real task.

zh: 能帮你把事做好一点，哪怕一点点，
en: If it helps you do that task even slightly better,

zh: 才值得继续往里投时间和钱。
en: then it may deserve more time and money.

zh: 现在我们在兰州，也还在对接一些企业，
en: Here in Lanzhou, we are also talking with businesses

zh: 愿意把自己的业务拿出来聊。
en: that are willing to put their real operations on the table.

zh: 看看流程里哪些地方AI能帮上忙，
en: We examine where AI can help inside their processes,

zh: 哪些地方根本不能乱动。
en: and which parts must not be changed carelessly.

zh: 有些事情已经有人愿意付费。
en: Some tasks already have people willing to pay.

zh: 有些事情还在验证。
en: Others are still being validated.

zh: 这个过程不快，
en: This process is not fast,

zh: 也没有短视频里讲得那么轻松。
en: and it is not as easy as short videos make it look.

zh: 但我不想因为还没拿到大结果，就告诉大家，
en: I do not want to say, just because I lack a major result,

zh: 学AI没用。
en: that learning AI is useless.

zh: 更不想因为有人晒了一张收款图，
en: Nor do I want one payment screenshot

zh: 就让大家一头扎进去。
en: to make everyone dive in blindly.

zh: 学AI，不是为了把自己变成又一个焦虑的人。
en: Learning AI is not about becoming one more anxious person.

zh: 先让它帮你把手里的真实工作，
en: First let it help with the real work already in your hands,

zh: 先做扎实。
en: and make that work solid.

zh: 能做出东西，能解决问题，
en: Produce something and solve a problem.

zh: 能让别人愿意用，
en: Make something others are willing to use.

zh: 后面的收入才有可能慢慢长出来。
en: Only then can income gradually grow from it.

zh: 如果你已经在真实工作里用过AI，
en: If you have already used AI in real work,

zh: 或者也在做这类尝试，
en: or are making similar attempts,

zh: 把你遇到的难处和结果，
en: share the difficulties and results you encountered.

zh: 发出来，
en: Put them out there,

zh: 让我们大家一起讨论。
en: and let us discuss them together.

zh: 我们一起把那些好看、热闹的东西，
en: Together, let us turn the flashy and exciting things

zh: 慢慢做成对普通人真正有用的东西。
en: into things that are genuinely useful to ordinary people.

zh: 都说创业九死一生。
en: People say entrepreneurship is a one-in-ten chance.

zh: 我这已经是第九回了，也该生了。
en: This is my ninth attempt, so perhaps it is finally time to survive.

zh: 现在能够借助AI提升自己的，
en: If you can improve yourself with AI now,

zh: 或者真的在某个环节有一技之长，
en: or already have a real skill in one part of the process,

zh: 先去面试这些岗位。
en: start by interviewing for relevant roles.

zh: 先去实战，磨练磨练。
en: Get real practice and build your ability.

zh: 不要轻易创业。
en: Do not start a business lightly.

zh: 试错就交给我。
en: Leave the trial and error to me.

zh: 成了，我再把经验分享给大家。
en: If it works, I will share the experience with everyone.

zh: 我是超哥，
en: I am Chao Ge,

zh: 在兰州AI创业。
en: building an AI business in Lanzhou.
